_meta.source: Round 13 - Direct CDS PDF extraction (SCU, LMU, ODU, Towson)
_meta.purpose: Private and regional university residency admit rates from official CDS PDFs

schools.notes: SCU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 18970 (in-state 9358 / oos 7310 / intl 2302), admitted 9105 (in-state 4536 / oos 3875 / intl 694). Intl 30.1% notably lower than domestic (~48-53%). OOS slightly higher than in-state.

LMU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 23089 (in-state 12431 / oos 8141 / intl 2517), admitted 10409 (in-state 6332 / oos 3921 / intl 156). Intl EXTREMELY selective at 6.2% vs domestic 49-51%. LMU has limited intl capacity relative to demand.

ODU CDS 2024-25: applied 15100 (in-state 11074 / oos 3765 / intl 261), admitted 13645 (in-state 10345 / oos 3055 / intl 245). Near-open admissions; intl 93.9% and in-state 93.4% nearly identical. OOS slightly lower at 81.1%.

Towson CDS 2024-25 C1: applied in-state 14591 / oos 4748 / intl 438, admitted in-state 12066 / oos 3772 / intl 374. Near-open admissions; all groups 79-86%. Intl 85.4% slightly higher than in-state 82.7%.
